Name: Hanan, Son of Igdaliah
Summary: Hanan, son of Igdaliah, was a man of God whose sons had a chamber in the temple, beside the chamber of the princes, where Jeremiah tested the Rechabites with wine.
KeyStory: Jeremiah brought the Rechabites into the chamber of the sons of Hanan the man of God and set wine before them, which they refused.
LifeLesson: A godly man's household can become the setting where another family's faithfulness is proved.
